components.name: Primary installation action
components.description: Installed anchor action from DocsOverview.vue. This text-only specimen omits its decorative arrow glyph. No distinct active or disabled state exists.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 13px 20px; font-family: var(--vp-font-family-base, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 24px; text-decoration: none; background: #b51c27; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #b51c27; border-radius: var(--study-radius, 2px); transition: background .18s ease-out; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #97131e; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-1, #ff7778); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-action-primary { transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Secondary authentication action

components.css: .ds-action-secondary { font-family: var(--vp-font-family-base, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 24px; color: var(--vp-c-text-1, #f5f3f0); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #ff7778); } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-1, #ff7778); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Overview reference link

components.name: Credential-free command example

narrative.overview:
This system covers the production documentation website only. It does not govern the native Rust CLI, terminal output, or MCP responses. Original red gate artwork and a white and red wordmark carry the fantasy identity. Quiet reading surfaces, clear links, and restrained borders support long references.

Gatehouse is the autonomous production default, not an explicitly approved visual direction. Dark mode opens by default; readers can select light mode. The confirmed brief asks for a fantasy feeling related to D&D Beyond without copied artwork or branding. Five working comparison studies remain separate from this system.
keyCharacteristics: Original red, white, and black identity assets.
Dark and light reading surfaces with theme-aware link accents.
Flat sections, solid dividers, and compact control corners.
Responsive reference navigation with local search.

rules.name: The Mark Backing Rule
rules.body: Keep the white and red wordmark on its permanent charcoal backing in both modes.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Use tonal grounds and solid dividers for the custom reading sections rather than adding decorative elevation.

dos: **Do** use the original Beyond Gate identity assets and retain the wordmark backing.
**Do** select the dark or light semantic colors as a set.
**Do** preserve solid keyboard focus and the reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** retain readable line lengths, scrollable commands, and mobile stacking.
**Do** keep user references distinct from development navigation.
donts: **Don't** treat comparison studies as production tokens or components.
**Don't** present the autonomous Gatehouse default as explicit visual approval.
**Don't** infer form, validation, or status variants from static command examples.
**Don't** use dashed or dotted UI outlines.
**Don't** turn the observed display-face and glyph drift into reusable rules.
